headline: IHCL Opens 400th Operating Hotel with Taj Yelahanka Launch in Bengaluru
summary: Indian Hotels Company Limited launched the 256-room Taj Yelahanka, marking its 400th hotel overall and expanding its partnership with Krishna GVK.
why: IHCL (Taj Group) is India's largest hospitality enterprise, expanding rapidly to meet business travel demand across tech hubs.

impacts.name: Indian Hotels Company
impacts.why: IHCL expanded its active hotel network to 400 properties with its latest opening.
